name: @diplodoc/transform
description: A simple transformer of text in YFM (Yandex Flavored Markdown) to HTML
author: YFM Team <yfm-team@yandex.ru>

scripts.build: npm run build:lib && npm run build:dist
scripts.build:lib: npm run patch:svgo && tsc -p tsconfig.transform.json && node scripts/build-svgo.mjs && node scripts/build-vendor-declarations.mjs && node scripts/build-public-api.mjs && npm run build:browser
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.test:playwright: npm run build && npm run test:playwright:nobuild --
